name: search
description: A clear circular search lens with a short angled handle.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: The circular lens is an intentional silhouette exception. A single 45-degree handle meets the circle at its centerline, with a rounded free end. Combined centerline bounds x/y=3.3..20.7 balance the grid. Owner-approved source. Outline-only icon by owner direction; no Filled variant.
